[[Woe Spreader]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Sessk, Woe Spreader]], a [[boss]] in [[Maishang Hills]], and [[Xiriss Stickleback]], a boss in [[Archipelagos]] only during [[Night Raiders]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Death Magic spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Health +30

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elliptical Staff]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. All collector and crafter staves that require Death Magic inflict [[cold damage]].


It is possible to create a cold damage version of this item with:
*One of the following Death Magic staves:
**[[Bone Staff]] from collectors [[Keotah]], [[Luven Underwood]], [[Merin Trollsbane]], or [[Adept Bishu]] or crafters [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Theodosus]]
**[[Lotus Staff]] from collector [[Buk Dirayne]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following Death Magic staves:
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Boneclaw Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*Perfect Hale Staff Head
*Perfect Staff Wrapping of Fortitude
*Perfect [["Aptitude not Attitude"]] inscription
